神阵（神阵（第22页）“现在，游戏开始了！”
玄衍界神抬手轻挥，亿万神纹瞬间流光暴涨，整座大阵轰鸣震颤，无边阵道之力碾压而下！
“今日，你们三人，便葬身此处，化作阵纹养料，成全本尊阵道万古盛名！”
话音落下，玄衍界神眸光一冷，单手结印，操控无上大阵，发动绝杀攻势！
轰隆——第一道阵杀之力轰然降临！
亿万金色神纹凝聚一体，化作千万柄横贯长空的神圣诛天仙剑，每一柄都蕴含诸天禁制之力、神王级杀伐底蕴，密密麻麻、遮天蔽日，从四面八方、上下寰宇，同时斩向三人！
剑光覆雨、封锁十方、无处可避、无路可逃！
洛千凝素手轻扬，周身灰白混沌剑意瞬间暴涨千万倍！
无边混沌道域铺开，笼罩三人周身，万千混沌剑丝纵横交错，自成绝对剑道领域！
叮叮当当——漫天神圣诛天仙剑疯狂斩击在混沌剑域壁垒之上，惊天撞击之声连绵不绝，神光炸裂、剑气纵横，整片阵界剧烈震颤！
无数诛天仙剑崩碎湮灭，可大阵生生不息、源源不断，破碎一柄、再生十柄，无穷无尽、无休无止！
李宝臻重瞳绽放圣光，双手快速结印，浩瀚乾坤大道全面爆发！
阴阳轮转、天地固化，厚重无边的乾坤结界笼罩三人外围，层层叠叠、固若金汤，辅助洛千凝稳固防御，抵挡无尽阵杀攻势。
陈凡目光带着几分凝重，《九天鸿蒙经》运转到极致！
火焰、极寒、空间、湮灭数十大道同时迸发，万道合一，凝练浩瀚鸿蒙道域，承接所有阵道碾压之力！
无尽阵杀攻势轰落，鸿蒙道域剧烈震荡、层层涟漪炸开，陈凡肉身受阵力反噬，筋骨微裂、气血翻腾，体表渗出细密血珠。
陈凡对于阵法的理解远超常人，然而当他们陷入阵法的那一刻，他竟然毫无察觉。
所以从一开始，陈凡就已经意识到对手的厉害。

果不其然，对方带给他的压力前所未有的大。
不过，陈凡在受伤之后，不灭战体的威能也开始显现，修行疯狂攀升。
“这么快就动用秘法了？真是可怜。”
玄衍界神立于虚空，不屑地盯着陈凡，“一个小小的大罗金仙，也的确不值一提！”
第二重绝杀禁制开启——万神噬道劫！
大阵之内，亿万神纹化作漫天神魔虚影，万千神族太古大能幻影现世，咆哮震天、噬道吞灵，疯狂撕扯三人的道域、吞噬三人的大道之力！
神魔虚影无处不在，啃噬鸿蒙道韵、消融混沌剑意、瓦解乾坤规则，从根源之上，瓦解三人修为根基！
与此同时，龙族秘地方向，一道道更加急促、更加绝望的神魂噩耗，疯狂涌入陈凡识海。
敖宫率领的残部真的快坚持不下去了！

God's Formation (God's Formation (page 22)) "Now, the game begins!"
Xuanyan Realm God raised his hand and waved lightly, and the billions of divine patterns instantly surged. The entire formation roared and trembled, and the boundless power of the formation was crushed down!
"Today, the three of you will be buried here and become the nourishment of the formation pattern, fulfilling the eternal fame of this deity's formation path!"
After the words fell, Xuanyan Realm God's eyes turned cold, he formed a seal with one hand, controlled the supreme formation, and launched a decisive offensive!
Boom - the first array of killing power came with a crash!
Billions of golden divine patterns condensed into one, turning into thousands of sacred heaven-slaying swords that stretched across the sky. Each sword contained the power of the prohibition of the heavens and the foundation of god-king-level killing. They were densely packed, covering the sky and the sun, and slashed at three people from all directions, up and down the world at the same time!
The sword light covers the rain, blocking all directions, leaving no place to hide and no way to escape!
Luo Qianning raised her hand lightly, and the gray and white chaotic sword energy around her body instantly increased ten million times!
The boundless realm of chaos spread out and enveloped the three of them. Thousands of chaotic sword threads crisscrossed each other, forming an absolute realm of swordsmanship of its own!
Ding-ding-ding-ding-the sky-wide sacred Heaven-Slaying Immortal Sword slashed crazily on the barrier of the Chaos Sword Territory. The shocking sound of impact was continuous, the divine light exploded, the sword energy was vertical and horizontal, and the entire formation trembled violently!
Countless Heaven-Slaying Immortal Swords collapsed and were destroyed, but the formation was endless and endless. Once one was broken, ten more swords were regenerated, endless and endless!
Li Baozhen's double pupils bloomed with holy light, his hands quickly formed seals, and the vast avenue of the universe exploded in full force!
The yin and yang rotated, the heaven and the earth solidified, and the thick and boundless Qiankun barrier enveloped the three people. The layers were stacked and impregnable, assisting Luo Qianning to stabilize his defense and resist the endless killing offensive.
Chen Fan's eyes were somewhat solemn, and the "Nine Heavens Hongmeng Sutra" was operating to the extreme!
Dozens of avenues of flame, extreme cold, space, and annihilation burst out at the same time. Ten thousand avenues merged into one, condensing the vast Hongmeng Dao Domain, and taking on the crushing power of all formations!
The endless formation killing offensive crashed down, Hongmeng Dao Domain shook violently, and ripples exploded. Chen Fan's body was backfired by the formation force, his muscles and bones were slightly cracked, his energy and blood were churning, and fine blood beads oozed from his body surface.
Chen Fan's understanding of formations was far beyond ordinary people, but the moment they fell into the formation, he was completely unaware of it.
So from the very beginning, Chen Fan was already aware of how powerful his opponent was.
As expected, the pressure brought by the other party on him was unprecedentedly high.
However, after Chen Fan was injured, the power of the immortal battle body also began to appear, and his practice increased crazily.
"Using the secret method so quickly? How pitiful."
Xuanyan Realm God stood in the void and stared at Chen Fan with disdain, "A small Da Luo Jinxian is indeed not worth mentioning!"
The second level of ultimate killing ban is opened - the catastrophe of the Devouring Dao of All Gods!
Within the great formation, billions of divine patterns turned into phantoms of gods and demons all over the sky. Thousands of ancient powerful phantoms of the gods appeared in the world, roaring to the sky, devouring Dao and souls, madly tearing apart the Dao domain of three people and devouring the power of the Dao of three people!
The phantoms of gods and demons are everywhere, gnawing at Hongmeng Daoyun, dissolving the chaotic sword intent, disintegrating the rules of the universe, and disintegrating the foundation of the three people's cultivation from the root!
At the same time, in the direction of the dragon clan's secret place, more urgent and desperate news about the souls poured into Chen Fan's sea of consciousness.
The remnant troops led by Ao Gong really can't hold on any longer!
